svg.aria-label: Design system architecture: tokens and DESIGN.md are authored, design:export checks the contract and Terrazzo builds light and dark stylesheets, Tailwind 4 feeds the components with roles only, and four checks enforce it on every edit and commit.
svg.title: Design system architecture
svg.desc: Four columns. Authored: the palette, the roles and the resolver in tokens/, and the components contract and rules in DESIGN.md. Build: design:export checks the components contract before the build, then Terrazzo resolves light and dark. Generated, never edited: tokens.generated.css holds every token as a variable; theme.generated.css holds the roles as the Tailwind theme with a dark variant. Consumed: Tailwind 4, its default palette reset and dark mode following the system or the toggle, feeds the components, which use role classes only; the palette stops before the components, where the lint fails. Below, four checks run on every edit and commit, as errors for an agent and warnings for a human: the ESLint design rules, design:lint, design:export --check and the agent hooks.
svg.text: Enforcement, on every edit and commit
palette stops: no class, lint fails
